en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of an elaborate, historic building labeled 'Sundsvall. Hirschska huset.' on the front. The structure appears to be a classic European urban edifice, with ornate architectural details, a tower central to the roof, and a wide facade. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, a green Swedish stamp (SVERIGE), a postal cancellation from Sundsvall, and is addressed to Stockholm.
